title: Heart of Myriad
text: With sufficient power, a heart floats above the codex. Take it with an empty main hand, then place it on a block face or right-click air to place it in a nearby empty space ahead. Pixel boundaries preview its range and a dotted link marks its source. Once placed, right-click the codex empty-handed to configure it. Use the placed heart directly with an empty main hand to pick it up again; breaking it recalls it to the codex.

The heart is a temporary placement marker. Switching items, releasing, dropping or breaking it recalls it; deliberate placement keeps the marker. Beyond 32 blocks it fades once per second and returns after ten seconds. Returning within range cancels the fade.

Only one linked heart can be valid at a time. It is not a material and cannot go inside portable containers. Losing power recalls it. Execution recalls it automatically, and the accepted world edit can continue even if its codex is erased.
